items.question: What does Defy The Odds Creative Co. do?
items.answer: We're a creative marketing agency for growing businesses. We bring strategy, content creation, video production and social media management together under one partner, so you can run your business while we make sure people notice it.

items.question: What is the free Marketing Checkup?
items.answer: It's a no cost review of how your business shows up online today. You fill out a short form, we look at your social media, website and content, and then we walk you through what we found on a 15 minute call. You'll leave with clear next steps whether you hire us or not.

items.question: Who do you work with?
items.answer: Established, growth minded service businesses that know they need stronger marketing but don't have the time, strategy or team to do it consistently. If you've outgrown doing it yourself but aren't ready to hire a full marketing department, we're a good fit.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We focus on Rockingham County, Guilford County and the greater Piedmont Triad, including Greensboro, Reidsville, Eden, High Point, Winston-Salem, Kernersville and Burlington. We also take on work elsewhere in North Carolina and beyond when it's the right fit.

items.question: Do you do one time projects or only monthly work?
items.answer: Both. Most of our clients work with us on an ongoing monthly basis because consistency is what gets results. We also take on select video productions and marketing campaigns as standalone projects.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every business is different, so we don't sell one size fits all packages. After your Marketing Checkup we recommend a plan built around your goals and walk you through clear options. No pressure and no surprise fees.

items.question: Do you run paid ads?
items.answer: Paid advertising is something we're building into our campaigns. If it's part of your goals, bring it up on your free Marketing Checkup call and we'll talk through what makes sense for your business.

items.question: Do you build websites or do SEO?
items.answer: We stay focused on strategy, content, video, social media and campaigns. If you need a website or SEO work, we're happy to point you to people we trust.
